assessments.name: Assessment 4: Exam - Case Study
assessments.description: Students must respond to structured questions, demonstrating critical analysis of the case, understanding of relevant theories, and proposing appropriate nursing interventions or strategies.

assessments.name: Assessment 1: Individual Short Case Study
assessments.description: Students will analyse a short case study and respond to two structured questions during class, reflecting on personal assumptions and biases while applying key concepts from Weeks 1–2, such as health inequities and social determinants of health.

assessments.name: Assessment 2: Group poster presentation
assessments.description: Group poster presentation using an A0 academic poster during a walk-around session during tutorial class, where members explain their poster and evaluate others’ work.

assessments.name: Assessment 3: Reflective digital storytelling and script
assessments.description: Create a 6–8 minute digital story reflecting on your social location, biases, and learning journey. Address the healthcare barriers faced by a marginalised group and propose equity strategies. Submit both the video and script.
